proposal.summary: ImageMagick 7.1.0-49 contains a vulnerability where parsing a crafted PNG can leave the convert process waiting for stdin input, allowing an attacker to crash the program and cause denial of service.
proposal.cwe_quote:
When it parses a PNG image (e.g., for resize), the convert process
could be left waiting for stdin input.

AV.quote:
The attacker can easily send a malicious png file to the victim and
then when the victim has opened this png he will crash the program.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain a sample PoC from the provided repository and reproduce locally to confirm the crash, then determine whether a patch is available or if input validation/tighter PNG parsing prevents blocking on stdin.
